additions: Added the ability to configure the root cycles of the routes for world 5
changes: Moved from React to Svelte for better performance and a smaller bundle size
A complete rewrite of the codebase as well as a redesign of the UI
Updated some predefined data for points and routes
bugfixes: Fixed an issue where the last column would not be loaded at all when uploading a CSV file (it was never noticed because those columns were rarely used)

additions: Added some small hints to help with inputs that can have a list of values separated by commas
changes: Limited the amount of points / routes to 256

additions: Added the ability to configure the way hardcoded strings are displayed in the UI (e.g. whether to show the internal names or the more user-friendly / descriptive ones)
Added more validators to prevent level points from unlocking themselves
changes: User input in the unlocked levels and bones inputs is now restricted if the point name of that row is not a level
bugfixes: Fixed an issue where the validator for levels after a secret exit is cleared would show the hint regarding spaces if the levels after clear column had spaces in it
Fixed an issue where only the "Active Root Cycles" column would be part of the Route CSV file if the world was determined to not be world 5
